branches.label: U2 continuity
branches.summary: Issue 73 is claimed and the Unit 2 repro landed. Diagnosis for the plan must follow that posted evidence, not a fresh guess.

nodes.title: Claim and repro issue 73
nodes.detail: Continuity issue is codepath/pathreview-ai301-fa26-s1#73 (Yie Sheng Chen / speculaas): README Quick Start asks for OPENROUTER_API_KEY while .env.example only shows LLM_PROVIDER=mock and OPENAI_API_KEY. core/config.py already defines both key fields. House-issue track only if this path is blocked.

nodes.title: Unit 2 repro of key docs mismatch
nodes.detail: Unit 2 repro is done and posted (grounded at commit f89c06f). Homework before-state is those same steps failing; after-state is the same steps with the expected output stated first. Do not reopen the live upstream issue pages during calibration — grade package snapshots only.

branches.label: Live activity
branches.summary: Today's room is ungraded calibration (Teach Claude to Grade a Plan). Drafts are ready in the activity note. The Doc itself is still open. This board does not replace the worksheet.

nodes.title: Session prep note written
nodes.detail: beat-1-sandbox/unit-3/2026-09-29-unit3-session-prep.md is the coach note: timing, three skill components, install/eval commands, and the homework sequence. Portal submit stays the separate ai301-coursework repo root.

nodes.title: Activity-today drafts ready
nodes.detail: 2026-09-30-unit3-activity-today.md has the ordered checklist and DRAFT paste fills, plus a lecture scope pair for issue 73 (docs/.env.example only; not core/config.py, providers, UI, or unrelated docs). Tonight's Doc shape is the downloaded worksheet + L3 breakout, not the older plan_worksheet.md member-section swap. Google Doc URL is still TBD — do not invent it.

nodes.title: OPEN grade calib-03 with sample
nodes.detail: Phase 1 (~10 min): one reader says each sample-procedure step aloud; the group does only what that step says. Package is calib-03. Literal sample checks can yield ready while staff correct verdict is hold — the wrong cause (pager bindings vs highlighting timings) is the lesson. Do not grade the live GitHub issue.

nodes.title: OPEN own rubric and procedure
nodes.detail: Phase 2 (~15 min): fix every Phase 1 miss, starting with the check that let the wrong cause through. Each check needs what / where / pass condition / required-or-preferred, and the verdict rule must say what ? does. Procedure is four stages: read first, gather evidence, grade, verdict. Friction: ambiguous pass condition → rubric; no where-to-look → procedure.

nodes.title: OPEN test procedure on calib-01
nodes.detail: Phase 3 (~15 min): cold-execute your procedure on calib-01. Staff correct verdict is ready. If you held, name the rejecting check (often an over-tight automated-test demand). Last minutes: edit the rubric/procedure and list changes. Phase 4 is one debrief line. Optional calib-04 only if early — either verdict is defensible; do not start a confirming eval save-run in the room.

branches.label: Skill plan-check
branches.summary: Homework skill is three authored components plus a Unit 2 voice carry. Not started as graded files. Points: skill 8 of 25. Revision marks from the Doc fold in here; the worksheet itself is not a portal upload.

nodes.title: OPEN author rubric file
nodes.detail: rubric.md: plan ready/hold checks plus a verdict rule. Failure families to cover include diagnosis vs repro evidence, one bounded change, stranger-executable steps, an observable test outcome, honest unknowns, and a comment that respects the thread and repo conventions. A rubric with no comms checks cannot buy back thread-and-convention misses.

nodes.title: OPEN author evidence guide
nodes.detail: references/evidence-guide.md says where evidence lives in a plan package (issue/thread, repro block, diagnosis, scope pair, files, approach, test plan, risks, comment). Not a worksheet box tonight — write it when folding marks after class.

nodes.title: OPEN author procedure file
nodes.detail: procedure.md is new this unit. Fill the four stage headings (read order, evidence gathering, check execution, verdict assembly). SKILL.md says execute procedure.md. Operator-swap friction routes here. Claude cannot ask mid-grade, so the steps have to be executable as written.

nodes.title: OPEN carry Unit 2 voice guide
nodes.detail: voice-guide.md is carry-over from Unit 2: paste into the labeled slot. Extend only if the plan-comment register needs new rules. Not re-authored as new graded work.

branches.label: Eval confirm
branches.summary: Same 18/20 bar plus category floor. Cheap runs first. Only a full --save-run may write the submit log. Not done. Category with teeth: thread-and-convention (2 packages).

nodes.title: OPEN install plan-check skill
nodes.detail: One canonical install after the three components and voice carry are actually filled. Starter skill/ copies to ~/.claude/skills/plan-check/. Cohort scope.md may still be the staff placeholder — a scope-message stop means the skill ran but needs the instructor scope file.

nodes.title: OPEN cheap smoke not save-run
nodes.detail: From the starter eval/ directory. --limit 3 does not write eval-run.txt. procedure.md is picked up next to the rubric by default. Use --only on disagreements (~$0.20/pkg) and add canaries if you loosen a check. Do not hand-edit a future eval-run.txt.

nodes.title: OPEN confirming save-run bar
nodes.detail: Aim at 18/20 plus the category floor (no points attached to 18 itself). Eval + write-up is 10 of 25. ONLY the full run may write eval-run.txt (~$4). Do not start this in the live room.

nodes.title: OPEN thread-and-convention floor
nodes.detail: thread-and-convention is two packages and is the category with teeth this week. Categories also include clear accepts (including honest scoped-down), scope creep, wrong cause, and unbuildable. Volume of other passes does not buy these misses back.

branches.label: Plan and build 73
branches.summary: Plan and build is 7 of 25 and is homework, not the live activity. plan.md stays in the course repo. Build is one bounded step at a time; no diff lands unread. Not done.

nodes.title: OPEN plan file in course repo only
nodes.detail: Six parts: diagnosis, scope pair (in / not-in), files, approach, test plan, risks. Diagnosis must follow the posted Unit 2 repro. Draft in-scope is docs/.env.example alignment for OPENROUTER_API_KEY (and LLM_PROVIDER visibility); not-in includes core/config.py defaults, provider behavior, UI, and unrelated docs. Place plan.md in coursework beat-1-sandbox/unit-3/, never on the fix branch. Placeholders in this preview repo are not the submit copies.

nodes.title: OPEN live check then post comment
nodes.detail: Read the thread. Promise only what the plan contains. Run live plan-check until accept JSON before posting. Scope-message stop is not a failed skill. Paste the posted comment under the link for grading. Do not post during the activity.
commands: claude "plan-check: grade my plan in plan.md and draft comment in comment.md for issue <URL>"

nodes.title: OPEN build on fix N-slug branch
nodes.detail: Branch on your fork: fix/<issue-number>-<slug> (issue 73). You drive, the model operates: one bounded step, read the diff, accept or redo. If intent changes, update plan.md, re-run live plan-check, and update the thread. Branch contents are not graded this week; Unit 4 reads the PR diff against plan.md. Do not push the plan file onto the branch.

nodes.title: OPEN rerun Unit 2 repro before after
nodes.detail: Decisive test: before = Unit 2 repro still showing the docs mismatch; after = the same steps with the expected output stated first. Record that evidence in plan-and-implement.md. Surface patches that ignore the repro are the wrong-cause failure.

branches.label: Submit
branches.summary: Due Mon Oct 5 2026 12:59 AM MDT. Portal link is the coursework repo root, not this trilogy-preview repo and not a folder URL. Not done.

nodes.title: OPEN upload tools plan-check
nodes.detail: Copy the installed skill into the submit repo at tools/plan-check/ (from ~/.claude/skills/plan-check/). This preview repo's docs/status board does not go in the submit repo.

nodes.title: OPEN fill unit-3 submit files
